summary: Distinguish integrated staged bytes from outstanding work-start scope

delivery.outcome: Observe only outstanding dirty contributions when a detached ancestor checkout has staged bytes already identical to the observed target. Preserve every checkout, index, ref, ticket and lease.
nonGoals: No cleanup, lease transfer, primary branch switch or allocator/adoption guard changes.
No exemption for active intent, named branches, unique commits, different staged/worktree content, unknown file types or incomplete observations.
No downstream source admission from an advisory report.

architecture.decision: Keep all dirty observations and digest bindings. Only for non-primary detached ancestor checkouts, exclude a path from pending-delta overlap when target blob/mode, stage-zero index entry and raw worktree blob/mode exactly agree. Recheck index/content/ref state before returning. Existing intent reservation, ancestry and ownership gates remain independent.
dataChanges: Observation digest additionally binds stage-zero/conflict index entries; no persistent state mutation.
architecture.rollback: Revert the observer change through independent protected publication; all source, index and lease evidence remains intact.

validation.evidence: Real Git detached ancestor with exact staged target bytes no longer reserves those paths; raw dirty observations, index bytes and refs are preserved.
Different index or raw bytes/mode, active named ticket, unique ancestry, missing observation and index-only race remain blocked.
Managed governance, focused regressions and required protected CI pass before independent approval.
